span.p: 04 / USE, TEST AND EXTEND THE LAB

YOUR INSTRUCTIONS → ONE WORKFLOW
OCNE lab · Database Operator · RAC · Application

READ & INSPECT
Project rules + Oracle guides
Windows host, storage, VMs, networks

SELECT & CLONE
Inspect the user-selected golden VM
Preserve source; use cloning workflow

PREPARE FOUR NODES
Unique identities · hosts entries · SSH keys
op 4/2 · cp 8/4 · workers 22/6 each
RAM GiB / vCPUs

OCNE 1.9 + KUBERNETES
Follow full Oracle procedure
Oracle Linux 9 / UEK R7

100 GiB on ocne-op
Verify mounted storage + all-node writes

div.style: color: rgb(19, 78, 74) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

Node, service, storage and SSH checks
Finish / correct the OCNE documentation

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

DATABASE OPERATOR
Prepare prerequisites
Install and verify controller

span.p:
RAC READINESS
Shared storage + networking + CVU
Stage slim image and patched 19.32 ZIPs
Review YAML · SGA 3 GiB · HugePages off

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

PROVISION & ACCEPT
Later deployment authorization recorded
Configure GI / ASM / RACCDB / LABPDB
Verify instances, SQL and patch status

APPLICATION WORKSTREAM
Frontend + Node.js + Python + Java
Develop → review → authorized deployment
Same cluster; RAC backend; test main URL

OPERATIONS & FAILOVER
Pod recreation · service / instance exercises
Capture expected vs actual results
Record recovery limits and untested cases

Two additional devices on both workers
SPAREDISKS · OTHERS · autoUpdate false
Verify ASM candidates; leave unallocated
